crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

children.name: Invoice Capture and Coding
children.blurb: Invoice capture and coding covers the intake of supplier invoices from paper, PDF, email and electronic formats, the extraction of header and line item data, and the assignment of general ledger accounts, cost centres, tax codes and project or department dimensions.

children.name: Customer Credit Risk
children.blurb: Customer credit risk in payables and receivables covers the likelihood that a customer will fail to pay an invoice on time or in full.

children.name: Programmable Settlement and Escrow
children.blurb: Programmable settlement and escrow covers systems that hold funds or payment instructions and release them automatically when predefined conditions are met.

children.name: Collections and Payment Plans
children.blurb: Collections and payment plans in the AI Accountant covers the systems that manage overdue invoices, schedule customer payments, and decide when to escalate or offer revised terms.

children.name: Working Capital Timing
children.blurb: Working capital timing covers the deliberate scheduling of cash inflows from receivables and outflows to payables to shorten the cash conversion cycle.

sections.body: Payables and receivables is the accounting work of tracking money a company owes and money owed to it. AI is used to read invoices, extract line items, match them to purchase orders and contracts, and route exceptions to people. It scores customers for credit risk using payment history and external signals. It can schedule payments, manage escrow conditions, and propose payment plans for overdue accounts. It also forecasts cash timing so a business can see when money will arrive and when bills will clear. These systems do not replace the ledger or the controller, they feed structured data into both.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: Invoice capture is largely solved for clean digital documents, and accuracy drops with scans, unusual formats, and handwritten notes. Credit risk models can rank customers, but they struggle with small private firms that have little public data. Programmable settlement and escrow work in narrow settings, often where a bank or a smart contract platform is already involved. Collections tools can prioritize accounts and draft messages, yet negotiation and hardship decisions remain human. Working capital timing is a forecasting problem, and forecasts are only as good as the payment behavior they learn from. The honest limit is that AI sees patterns in past transactions, not a customer's intent or a sudden cash crisis.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: The pages under this section follow the money from first document to final settlement. Invoice Capture and Coding is the entry point, where documents become ledger entries and coding rules are applied. Customer Credit Risk looks upstream at who is allowed to buy on terms and how much exposure is safe. Programmable Settlement and Escrow covers the mechanics of moving money under conditions, including automated release and holdbacks. Collections and Payment Plans deals with what happens after due dates pass, from reminders to structured repayment. Working Capital Timing ties these threads together by forecasting the gap between payables and receivables, so the sequence from capture to risk to settlement to collections to timing mirrors the cash conversion cycle.
